sources.title: AI Song Checker — Check If a Song Is AI-Generated
sources.snippet: An AI song checker is a tool that inspects a song and tells you whether it was generated by an AI model or created by people. You upload the song — 20 to 30 seconds with vocals is ideal — and the AI song checker returns a verdict, a probability score, and, when the song is flagged, the generator most likely behind it: Suno, Udio, Sonauto ...

sources.title: Is This Song AI? — Free AI Music Detector & Scanner | SlopTracker
sources.snippet: Check if a song is AI-generated. Paste any Spotify track or audio URL to instantly detect AI music using spectral and temporal audio analysis. Free, fast, and accurate.

sources.title: Free AI Music Checker - Detect If a Song Is AI Generated | authio
sources.snippet: How do I check if my song is AI generated? Upload your audio file (MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A or AIFF) to the checker above. Our 5-model neural ensemble analyzes spectral patterns, harmonic signatures, and temporal artifacts to determine if the track was generated by AI. Results arrive in under 30 seconds.
